title: On Hunting the fox across two fields
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：hunt　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hunt 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the athlete ① hunted the fox across two fields on the same day, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② hunts the fox across two fields before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hunt the fox across two fields at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ hunted the fox across two fields before — a line in the programme for September 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hunting the fox across two fields on the same day, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hunt through the old chest for the letter before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hunt through the old chest for the letter at once and never mention it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ hunts through the old chest for the letter on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ hunted the fox across two fields again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hunt the fox across two fields, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody hunts the fox across two fields before dawn again and somebody must hunt the fox across two fields on the same day all over again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hunt 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the athlete hunted the fox across two fields on the same day, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete hunts the fox across two fields before dawn whenever the stadium asks.
Hunting the fox across two fields on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hunt through the old chest for the letter before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium hunts through the old chest for the letter on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother hunted the fox across two fields again, and the stadium remembered that half.
